problems.title: THE TELESCOPE OF THE 7TH INTERNATIONAL OLYMPIAD ON ASTRONOMY & ASTROPHYSICS
problems.statement:
**SkyWatcher 150/750 Black Diamond EQ3-2**

**SPECIFICATIONS**

The telescope of the 7th International Olympiad on Astronomy & Astrophysics will be a **Newtonian reflector** telescope on equatorial mount constructed by the **SkyWatcher** company.

**SUMMARY**

- **Type**: Reflector telescope
- **Optical design**: Newtonian
- **Diameter:** 150 mm (5.91″) (parabolic)
- **Focal length:** F 750 mm
- **Focal Ratio:** f / 5
- **Focuser**: rack and pinion type (with 1.25″ adapter)
- **Mount:** EQ3-2 Equatorial with 2 knobs for manual movement in RA and Dec and calibrated position circles.
- **Tripod:** Aluminum legs with adjustable height (71–123 cm) and leveling bubble
- **Finder:** achromatic 6×30 (inverted image)
- **Eyepieces:** SUPER Plossl 25mm (30×) WA, LE and SUPER Plossl 10mm (75×), Ø31.8mm
- **Barlow:** 2×, achromatic
- **Maximum Usable Magnification:** 300 ×
- **Minimum Star Magnitude Size:** m$_{\mathrm{V}}$ = 13.6
- **Theoretical Resolution:** 0.8 arc sec

Photograph looking into the open front end of the telescope tube, showing the secondary mirror held by a four-vane spider and the focuser with an eyepiece on the side of the tube.
Photograph of the 6×30 finder scope in its bracket with adjustment screws.
